## 🌡️ MARKET ATMOSPHERE

1. Global Risk Regime?  
CAUTION. Breadth: 2/11 sectors positive. SPY BELOW TREND (1W: -2.36% | 1M: -4.02%) and VXX ABOVE TREND (1W: +9.44% | 1M: +18.92%) confirm elevated volatility while HYG/LQD shows CREDIT STRESS ↑ (HYG (1W: -0.80% | 1M: -1.62%) BELOW TREND; LQD (1W: -0.88% | 1M: -2.68%) BELOW TREND), offset by commodity reflation in XLE ABOVE TREND (1W: +4.66% | 1M: +11.04%).

2. Primary Risk Drivers?  
Credit stress rising: HYG/LQD ↓ falling (credit spreads widening; Credit Spread Level 0.7308 ↑). Volatility elevated: VXX ↑ rising ABOVE TREND (1W: +9.44% | 1M: +18.92%). Reflation bias in energy: CPER_GLD ↑ rising and XLE ABOVE TREND (1W: +4.66% | 1M: +11.04%).

3. Financial Conditions Signal?  
Neutral-to-tightening: Dollar CORRECTION (UUP 1W: -0.11% | 1M: +2.07%) and TLT BELOW TREND (1W: -1.65% | 1M: -3.84%) with the yield curve BELOW TREND (↓ falling), implying tighter real conditions despite energy reflation.

📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

4. Sector Leadership?  
Energy leading: XLE ABOVE TREND (1W: +4.66% | 1M: +11.04%). Tech weak: XLK BELOW TREND (1W: -2.31% | 1M: -1.59%). Financials in RECOVERY (XLF RECOVERY (1W: +0.94% | 1M: -3.32%)) — style: Value/Cyclicals favored but narrow given 2/11 breadth.

5. US vs Global?  
Broad weakness offshore: SPY BELOW TREND (1W: -2.36% | 1M: -4.02%), FEZ BELOW TREND (1W: -3.05% | 1M: -10.63%), EEM BELOW TREND (1W: -3.80% | 1M: -8.32%), FXI BELOW TREND (1W: -4.20% | 1M: -8.63%); US not immune but relatively less dispersion.

6. Speculative Appetite?  
Speculation cooling: IBIT CORRECTION (1W: -7.07% | 1M: +7.47%) and ARKK BELOW TREND (1W: -5.56% | 1M: -1.43%); small caps IWM BELOW TREND (1W: -0.51% | 1M: -4.33%) — appetite reduced and selective.

🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

7. Commodities Theme?  
Oil/energy reflation: BNO ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.61% | 1M: +46.65%) and XLE ABOVE TREND (1W: +4.66% | 1M: +11.04%). Metals and precious metals weak: CPER BELOW TREND (1W: -5.28% | 1M: -6.53%), GLD BELOW TREND (1W: -12.01% | 1M: -16.03%).

8. Energy Trend?  
Energy leadership clear: XLE ABOVE TREND (1W: +4.66% | 1M: +11.04%); natural gas weak: UNG BELOW TREND (1W: -3.85% | 1M: -0.09%).

🧭 STRATEGY

9. Trend Confirmation?  
CONFIRMED: XLE ABOVE TREND across both frames and VXX ABOVE TREND (volatility spike). DIVERGENCE: multiple 1W vs 1M CORRECTIONS (USO, IBIT, ETHA, PDBC) signal short-term mean-reverts; no MAJOR divergence across core ETFs, so signals are mixed but tilted defensive.

10. Portfolio Direction?  
Favor energy/financial exposure (XLE ABOVE TREND; XLF RECOVERY) while reducing exposure to broad growth/tech beta (XLK BELOW TREND; QQQ BELOW TREND). Monitor bonds/TLT and credit spreads for risk-off flips.

🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Sectors to Watch?  
BULLISH: XLE ABOVE TREND (1W: +4.66% | 1M: +11.04%) and Energy/Materials if BNO momentum holds. BEARISH: XLK BELOW TREND (1W: -2.31% | 1M: -1.59%), Real Estate BELOW TREND (1W: -5.79% | 1M: -6.50%) and Consumer Staples weak.

12. Commodities to Watch?  
BULLISH: BNO ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.61% | 1M: +46.65%) and oil-linked ETFs. BEARISH: GLD BELOW TREND (1W: -12.01% | 1M: -16.03%), SLV BELOW TREND (1W: -12.15% | 1M: -21.87%), CPER BELOW TREND (1W: -5.28% | 1M: -6.53%).

13. Key Levels?  
VXX ~30 (elevated; current VIX/VXX regimes showing volatility), HYG/LQD ~0.73 (credit stress threshold; Level 0.7308 ↑), XLK/XLF ~2.76 (tech vs financials pivot).

📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

CAUTION. Breadth: 2/11 sectors positive.  
Energy XLE ABOVE TREND (1W: +4.66% | 1M: +11.04%) and Financials XLF RECOVERY (1W: +0.94% | 1M: -3.32%) showing relative strength.  
Key risk: volatility VXX ABOVE TREND (1W: +9.44% | 1M: +18.92%) and rising credit stress (HYG (1W: -0.80% | 1M: -1.62%) BELOW TREND) — monitor IBIT/commodity corrections.
